content.comment_body: I have a [article_no] device, which provides 8 digital inputs and 6 relay outputs. In my [product_name] project, the [article_no] standard hardware is configured, but I can only access 6 digital inputs.

Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. Your [product_name] with [article_no] is not actually a [version_no] in the hardware selection, but rather a [version_no]. For this [product_name], you need the current [version_no] of [product_name] software. Upgrading to [product_name] [version_no] can be done via the download link, but note this download is subject to export restrictions. You’ll need to log in and register to access export-restricted software; certain data will be required for this process.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing confusion due to differences between hardware versions or codes and product configuration within the software. The main issue is a mismatch between the physical hardware's features (such as the number of digital inputs) and what is available through the software configuration, resulting in users being unable to fully access all device functions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] software to automatically recognize their specific hardware module and enable access to all available digital inputs in line with the actual device capabilities.
